title: UAE離脱のOPECプラス、有志7カ国で結束維持　6月に原油増産
extracted_text: 主要産油国でつくる石油輸出国機構（OPEC）プラスの有志7カ国は3日のオンライン会合で、6月に日量18万8千バレルの原油を増産することを決めた。世界の石油需要の約0.2%に相当する。アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）のOPEC脱退後、初めての会合だったが、7カ国で結束を維持した。 今回の引き上げ幅は、離脱したUAEの割り当て分を除くと、4月に決めた5月の増加幅（20万6千バレル）と同水準だ。7カ国は会合後の声明で「各国は市場動向を継続的に注視・評価する」とし、UAE脱退については言及しなかった。 ただ、世界の石油供給量の約2割が通過するホルムズ海峡がイランによって事実上封鎖されており、7カ国のうちサウジアラビアやイラク、クウェートは減産を余儀なくされている。OPEC非加盟の有志国のうちロシアもウクライナによるドローン攻撃で生産設備の被害が出ている。 このため、増産の決定は3カ月連続だが、あくまで「計画上」の意味合いが強い。ホルムズ海峡が封鎖されたままでは大部分の輸出に限界がある。通航が再開されても、供給の正常化には数週間から数カ月はかかる見通しだ。
translated_text: The seven voluntary countries that make up OPEC+ decided at an online meeting on the 3rd to increase oil production by 188,000 barrels per day in June. This corresponds to about 0.2% of global oil demand. It was the first meeting since the United Arab Emirates (UAE) left OPEC, but the seven countries maintained unity. The size of this increase, excluding the UAE's allocated quota that withdrew, is at the same level as the increase for May (206,000 barrels) decided in April. In a statement after the meeting, the seven countries said, "Each country will continue to closely monitor and evaluate market trends," but did not address the UAE's withdrawal. However, the Strait of Hormuz, through which about 20% of the world's oil supply passes, is effectively blocked by Iran, forcing Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Kuwait among the seven countries to implement production cuts. Russia, a non-OPEC member among the voluntary countries, has also seen production facilities damaged by Ukrainian drone attacks. For this reason, the decision to increase production has been consistent for three consecutive months, though its significance remains primarily on a "planned" basis. With the Strait of Hormuz remaining blocked, most exports face significant limitations, and even if navigation resumes, normalization of supply is expected to take several weeks to months.
title_en: OPEC+ After UAE Withdrawal, 7 Member Countries Maintain Unity; June Oil Production Increase
